descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for a Embedded Systems Engineer that is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing software (firmware) that interfaces directly with physical hardware components. The role requires a deep understanding of hardware-software co-design, resource optimization, and real-time computing to deliver reliable, efficient, and high-performance embedded products.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES 
 Firmware Development: Design, code, and test low-level software in C and C++ for bare-metal systems and Real-Time Operating Systems ( RTOS ).
 Driver & Peripheral Development: Write and maintain device drivers for hardware peripherals and communication interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB ).
 Hardware-Software Integration: Read, interpret, and analyze electrical schematics to map out pins, registers, and memory layouts accurately.
 Testing & Debugging: Diagnose, isolate, and debug hardware/software interaction defects using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters , and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
 Resource Optimization: Optimize system code for stringent physical constraints, including CPU utilization, RAM footprint, and ultra-low power consumption.
 Technical Documentation: Author clear software design specifications, API descriptions, register maps, and architectural block diagrams.
 TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS 
 Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or a related technical discipline.
 Programming Languages: Professional proficiency in C and C++ (specifically embedded dialects). Basic knowledge of Assembly is a plus.
 Hardware Knowledge: Hands-on experience with microcontroller and microprocessor architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex-M/A, RISC-V, ESP32, AVR ).
 Operating Systems: Practical experience working with RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) or Embedded Linux.
 Tools & Environment: Familiarity with compilers (GCC, Clang) and building/debugging tools (Make, CMake, GDB).
 SOFT SKILLS & COMPETENCIES 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and algorithmic thinking capabilities.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams alongside hardware engineers and high-level software application developers.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English .
 What We Offer 
A salary package designed to reflect your seniority, complemented by meal vouchers, a private medical subscription, annual performance reviews, and merit-based salary increases. Opportunity to work on large-scale, high-impact systems used globally.
A collaborative environment that encourages technical ownership and innovation
Access to modern tools and infrastructure
Professional growth opportunities within a fast-evolving product ecosystem
